answers.core:
The alternative would be to build and maintain an entirely separate Animation system as GDExtension and I would rather not. See also: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/3950

I believe an AnimationServer refactor like this would make the Animation system a lot more maintainable down the line, which is a good thing for both maintainers and users.

title: Add AnimationServer to support registering AnimationTrack types as extensions
